1_previous_convergence_state.note: All four corrected variants (stconv_v1, mpgru_v1, dgc_kriging_v1, dcgru_reconstruction_v1) had finite, decreasing training loss but no per-epoch validation loss in their Phase B training histories. The strict convergence gate interpreted this as convergence_caveated, blocking scientific_ready.

2_validation_policy_decision.policy: Option A — Add real validation tracking (preferred)
2_validation_policy_decision.description: A disjoint validation mask is carved from the observed (non-hidden) training support using a fixed seed. This avoids contaminating the test hidden support while providing genuine held-out loss supervision per epoch.
2_validation_policy_decision.fallback_profile: train_only_convergence — available for explicit declaration, not default

3_implementation_changes.change: Added STValidationSupport dataclass and _build_validation_support() method. For scientific-tier runs (training_tier=scientific), a masked validation tensor is synthesised from the observed support (10% rate, seed 43). Validation config keys are injected into algo_config and the support metadata is emitted as a validation_support_metadata artifact.

Extended _persist_st_lifecycle_artifacts() and _persist_st_prediction_artifact() to write validation_policy, validation_metric, requires_validation_tracking, validation_support_fingerprint, and related fields into runtime_summary.json and metadata.json when validation_support_metadata is present in the outcome.

Added optional fields to STTrainingConfig: validation_policy, validation_support_fingerprint, validation_split_id, validation_mask_seed, requires_validation_tracking. Updated to_dict() and from_dict() to preserve these fields.

Updated convergence semantics: missing validation loss only produces a caveat when requires_validation_tracking is true. When validation_policy == train_only_convergence or validation_metric == not_required, absence of validation loss is recorded as a protocol_note (not a caveat) and does not affect convergence_status.
STGCN (stconv_v1): training loop now computes per-epoch validation_loss when _validation_split is present in config. Loss is recorded into training history.
GRIN (mpgru_v1): training loop now computes per-epoch validation_loss when _validation_split is present in config.
IGNNK (dgc_kriging_v1): training loop now computes per-epoch validation_loss when _validation_split is present in config.
DCRNN (dcgru_reconstruction_v1): training loop now computes per-epoch validation_loss when _validation_split is present in config.
Created shared ST graph validation helper to remove circular import between GraphRuntimeProvider and the spatiotemporal services __init__.
Updated backfill path to normalise validation metadata from runtime_summary.json so existing records correctly reflect the new schema fields.

4_validation_support_metadata.note: Same fingerprint across all four algorithms — validation mask is deterministically generated from the same dataset, seed, and 10% observed-support rate, independent of the algorithm being trained.

warnings: fixed_support_graph_policy_sensitivity_not_run: SCI-FIX07 is optional and not required by this gate profile.
8_final_gate_status.note: scientific_ready=true reflects SCI-FIX09 infrastructure readiness: all Phase B evidence is clean and gate passes. Phase C (Tier A official run) has not been executed. The official Phase C scientific_ready claim requires completion of the Tier A multi-realization campaign.

9_decision_for_phase_c.rationale: All four corrected ST variants now have per-epoch validation loss recorded under a reproducible masked_validation_support policy. Convergence reports show convergence_passed for all four algorithms with no remaining caveats or blockers. The strict SCI-FIX09 gate passes completely. The validation_loss_missing blocker that prevented Phase C launch is resolved.
